results.name: Seven cosmetic skins include a default and a weighted rarity pool
Migration preserves valid legacy coins/skins and gives one free starter crate once
Malformed saves cannot invent unknown skins, reward IDs, negative money or infinite balance
Weighted random boundaries select rare, epic and legendary without default skin
Odds recalculate among remaining skins and every opening is unique
Free crate costs zero, paid crate costs exactly80, and insufficient coins cannot be charged
Reserved reward is persisted in inventory and cannot be charged twice while pending
All-unlocked state has no fee or free-crate consumption
UI offers a free crate immediately and reserves reward before the reel animation
Repeated clicks, premature claim, Escape, backdrop and start cannot interrupt or double-charge roll
Reload mid-roll restores exactly the same reward with no additional fee or free crate
UI keeps or equips explicitly and charges exactly80 for each subsequent new appearance
Collection card and crate handlers reject changes during a live or paused fight
Complete collection disables crate UI and no forged click charges coins
